**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

Section 22 (Audit Rights) is the only clause in the document granting Brightline any audit, inspection or verification right against Northwind — targeted searches for "audit", "inspection", "verification/records" and "remote access to Customer systems" surfaced nothing else, and § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains only a heading.

The clause meets each preferred element:
- **Frequency** — "no more than once in any twelve-month period"
- **Notice** — "at least thirty days' prior written notice"
- **Business hours** — "during normal business hours"
- **Independent auditor / confidentiality** — "an independent auditor bound by confidentiality"
- **Off-site** — "conducted off-site where practicable"
- **Cost** — "Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent"
- **No system access** — "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly"

Section 22.3 (audit findings are our Confidential Information, usable only to enforce the Agreement, with a copy of the final report and finality absent fraud) runs in our favour, so it is not flagged. No redline proposed.
